pages.title: Optional Discovery
pages.text: Harmonium changes how colors look. Its dyed forms and dealer offers are hidden by default. In a local world, see Gameplay → Features → Enable Harmonium. On a server, check with the host.
The stock recipe combines glowstone dust with dried tobacco.

pages.title: Change the Result
pages.text: Craft an existing Harmonium with dye to tint it. Use a pipe or bong with Harmonium in your inventory. Its stored dye controls the color effect. When enabled at startup, level-three dealers can stock dyed variants.
